answer_1.quote: Counter-argument generation task aims to automatically generate a statement that has a different stance from the original argument.

answer_2.quote: Previous work typically employed n-gram-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE for rapidly evaluating the quality of counter-argument generation.

answer_3.quote: We introduce a metric, ChatGPT Eval, which we obtain by using ChatGPT to score the sentence's position and argument completion.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a more detailed human evaluation. Five human judges are asked to rate arguments on a Likert scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best) across 5 dimensions to evaluate the performance of the systems
answer_4.guideline: rate arguments on a Likert scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best) across 5 dimensions
